mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE below 4% in the labor market recovery regime signals strong labor demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE remaining below 4% in the labor market recovery regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1% signals monetary normalization, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 1% for the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both quarterly demand (GDPC1) above 16,270 and housing demand (HOUST) above 1,174 signals expansionary demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and HOUST exceeding their respective thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) above 110 signals robust supply growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO remaining above 110 for the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) above 142,071 and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 5.3% signals a strong labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both PAYEMS exceeding 142,071 and UNRATE falling below 5.3.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) above historical averages signals robust growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in expanding supply regimes despite INDPRO being above historical averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a low unemployment phase, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE remaining below 4.5% for the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and inflation expectations (CPIAUCSL) above 237.786 signals constrained inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceeding their respective thresholds.
